title: connection.requested
description: Published by Connection Service when a requester sends a new connection request. Consumed by Notification Service (alert the recipient in real time).
_comment_event_driven: Connection Service has no idea Notification Service exists or what it does with this event — the producer only states a fact that already happened.
_comment_outbox: Connection Service writes this event to its outbox table in the same transaction that inserts the PENDING connection_requests row. Atomicity ensures the DB and Kafka never diverge.

connection_id.description: The connection request that was created.

requester_id.description: User who sent the connection request.

recipient_id.description: User who should be notified of the incoming request.
